bio:
Tree: Domenico G Fiorillo (d. 1770) + Cecilia Fata Scaff... (1738-1797). Unsupported (Round 2).

Grandson Domenico Fiorillo's 1849 death act places the family at Cannovali, a hamlet of Aiello Calabro, around 1775.
